description: Read a cited research brief for a covered U.S. ticker, ETF or released subject. Overview, current and full views support dated research and historical cutoffs. An explicit refresh requires current stock and SPY prices before payment. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

detail.description: Issuer_evidence lists retained SEC filing captures. To inspect a document, reuse its as_of with issuer_document_id and a literal issuer_query; continue with issuer_match_offset. This is a stored, metered evidence read without collection or model calls. Current returns up to three reviewed current Beliefs with up to three Risks and three Catalysts each, direct evidence URLs, clocks and explicit unknowns under 32KiB. Attached open Risks or materialized Risks with supported continuing relevance qualify, without age/severity exclusion; unknown concerns remain separately qualified. Selection reserves opposing views, then distinct stances, effective/publication recency, observed recency and stable ID. Omitted whole cases have continuations/detail references. Current is a stored read and cannot refresh. Start with overview for research questions: it includes complete selected cases, dated developments, assessment and citations. Full is for a complete machine export; oversized full company reads through MCP return an explicitly bounded overview with case IDs for get_case drill-down. REST detail=full retains the export. Fund briefs return fund_overview for either value.

entity_id.description: Released subject ID returned by get_subjects.

issuer_document_id.description: For detail=issuer_evidence, select a document_id returned by its inventory; also pass the returned as_of and a literal issuer_query.

issuer_match_offset.description: Continue with next_match_offset and unchanged ticker, as_of, issuer_document_id and issuer_query. Each read uses normal research allowance or credit.

issuer_query.description: Literal phrase to find across one complete retained SEC document. Returns up to five cited excerpts, including beyond cached text prefixes; no raw document export.

max_results.description: Maximum returned views. Overview returns at most five (default five); larger valid requests are capped at five with explicit returned and omitted counts. Full supports 1–20. Omit for an ordinary overview.

refresh_market_data.description: Current briefs serve prepared research and refresh a missing or stale requested-stock quote by default. Set false to retain stored quotes. Daily paths and benchmark context refresh during preparation. Historical reads never refresh.

name: get_brief

1g.description: Qualification at this read cutoff, separate from the unchanged recorded status. Provider capability describes supported inputs, not enabled monitoring. A current check does not validate the whole investment case.

anyOf.description: Business verification compares this exact published case with dated issuer evidence. Read the explanation and unknowns: a supported fact, management guidance and an achieved outcome are different. A mixed or unresolved case is not a false claim. Evidence after the information cutoff remains unreviewed.

exchange.description: Four-character exchange MIC, such as XLON, XTSE, XTKS or XHKG. Use with ticker.

relationship_coverage.description: Bounded direct links within this originating case. Absent or unknown means collection is unknown; incomplete means some support or endpoints are unavailable. No multi-hop completeness, causal magnitude or portfolio weights are claimed.

derivation.description: The sequence is BeliefState's composition, never a source-authored causal conclusion. Individual edge derivation remains unchanged.

edge_indexes.description: Ordered indexes into this investment_case.relationships list. Every intermediate edge remains present with its separate source/identity citations and derivation.

truncated.description: True when the requested edge-step budget prevents completing traversal within the requested depth.

available_at.description: Availability of the returned case and endpoint support at the requested cutoff.

citation_ids.description: Originating source Evidence supporting this relationship statement.

derivation.description: source_explicit is directly stated; source_implied follows the source argument; engine_inferred is BeliefState's inference and must never become the author's view.

identity_citation_ids.description: Endpoint identity support; these citations do not independently establish the relationship statement.

1r.description: Historical performance is stock/SPY price context after publication, sampled at the longest completed standard horizon. Preserve action, dates, return basis and eligibility. Unmeasured horizons remain unknown. Price movement does not verify claim truth, trades, profit or investor skill. Use get_case for all released windows when requested.

items.description: An exact source-backed argument between named mentions. Names are not globally resolved entities, and these citations do not establish canonical endpoint identity. Source observation, engine publication and author publication are separate clocks.

unit.description: Normalized base unit after applying source_scale; source_unit retains the printed unit.

2o.description: Stored source-capture scope. Null or absent means unknown; no value here verifies complete article coverage.

2p.description: Recorded storage flag, separate from verified source completeness. Null or absent means unknown.

3i.description: Reviewed extraction interpretation of the same source, available from recorded_at. Preserves attribution and conditions; creates no author revision or verified execution. canonical_evaluation references the original record; outcomes retain their own saved interpretation snapshots.

event_date.description: Announcement or occurrence date of the development; never substitute a fiscal period end or article publication date. Null when several events with different dates are discussed or timing is unknown.

anyOf.description: Stored claim qualifications, including source attribution, forecast and comparison periods, assumptions, limitations, definitions, prior state and causal context. These qualify the claim; they are not independently verified facts. Null or omitted means unavailable, not unconditional.

Business verification compares this exact published case with dated issuer evidence. Read the explanation and unknowns: a supported fact, management guidance and an achieved outcome are different. A mixed or unresolved case is not a false claim. Evidence after the information cutoff remains unreviewed.

market_context.description: Market context was omitted from this overview. Request a current full REST brief without as_of to check it again.

required_before_stance_summary.description: Open these omitted cases before summarizing the balance of bullish and bearish views.

omitted_recent_change_count.description: Changes omitted from the bounded full brief, not the total change journal.

limitation.const: Model comparison of captured observations; not an accepted author revision or proof of current holdings.
